remarks: This nicely updated Putnam Park turnkey co-op is just steps from parking area making easy access to the unit. Updated with high end appliances. Contains more square footage than a standard 2-bedroom unit!! Spacious and sunlit unit with welcoming foyer, spacious living room, comfortable dining area, galley kitchen and alcove perfect for computer/workspace, generous bedroom and bath. A stone terrace invites you to enjoy the outdoors. Putnam Park is located in the heart of Greenwich minutes from shops, train, library, hospital, parks and schools. Beautifully landscaped property with flowering shrubs makes leisurely walks a delight. Garage when available is at additional cost. Must see to fully appreciate!
